sources.title: A Survey of Autonomous LLM Agents
sources.full_text: Autonomous agents combine planning, tool use and memory. Hub-centric orchestration keeps workers stateless while the hub owns task state. Delegation traces make multi-agent decisions auditable.

sources.title: Queue Design Notes
sources.full_text: Backpressure protects downstream consumers. Bounded queues with explicit overflow policies beat unbounded buffering. Retries need idempotency keys.

sources.title: Context Budget Heuristics
sources.full_text: Context budgets should be enforced in characters and tokens. Diversity cuts prevent one source from dominating the bundle. Provenance metadata must survive reranking.
